claims.hypothesis: 3C 368's CO faintness is due to low metallicity
claims.experiment: Free-free+[OIII] and R23 metallicities; three gas-mass methods
claims.result: Z~0.3 Zsun both ways; gas masses agree and GDR within ~15% of expected
claims.finding: 3C 368 has sub-solar metallicity and Mgas~6.4e10 Msun

evidence.quote: Both methods agree on a sub-solar gas-phase metallicity of $\sim$ 0.3 Z$_\odot$.

claims.hypothesis: Radio core emission is star-formation free-free rather than AGN

evidence.quote: Unfortunately, our 230 GHz rest-frame ALMA observations (cite: Lamarche2017), with a synthesized beam of size 3$\ensuremath{''}$12 $\times$ 1$\ensuremath{''}$81, do not resolve the core of 3C 368.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Radio core emission from compact AGN synchrotron instead of free-free; not ruled out

evidence.quote: may instead come from a compact AGN (cite: Roellig1986)

limitations_admitted.value: Core continuum flux is a lower limit due to resolved-out extended emission

evidence.quote: making the quoted flux density from the core a lower limit on the true value.

referee_caveats_inferred: Metallicity relies on single [OIII] line, assumed T and density with factor-2 uncertainty
alpha_CO and r43/21 depend on a CO(2-1) limit
